Hi there,

Thanks for reaching out. I'm not able to book calls through outside calendar links, but I'm happy to help right here.

Tell me what you're looking for and I'll point you to the right unit: roughly what you want to spend, where it would run (a home office, a garage, a basement), and whether noise or power draw matters to you. I can confirm live price, stock and the ship date on anything in our lineup and send you a direct link or a ready-made checkout.

If this is about something our team needs to arrange directly, such as a bulk quote or an unusual payment method, just say so and I'll pass it to Georges, who picks it up today at 10am ET and replies to this address.

Sarah, HeliumDeploy

Hi there,

Thanks for the nudge, and here is where order Shop···· stands.
